from itertools import combinations
def count(lines):
    lines=[set(s.split()) for s in lines]
    pts=set().union(*lines)
    def col(a,b): return [i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if a in l and b in l]
    n=0
    for a,b,c in combinations(sorted(pts),3):
        ab,bc,ac=col(a,b),col(b,c),col(a,c)
        if ab and bc and ac and not (set(ab)&set(bc)&set(ac)): n+=1
    return n
n=count(['A B', 'A C', 'B D C', 'A E D', 'B E', 'C E'])
assert n==8
assert n!=9
assert n!=11
assert n!=10
